metadataReview.coordinateBasis: The GDOŚ natural-monument WFS returns feature PL.ZIPOP.1393.PP.2808032.773 (object: glacial erratic, single object, established 1952-12-29, no name) at longitude 21.430819443501466, latitude 54.09180284543056, rounded to [21.4308,54.0918]. The Encyklopedia Warmii i Mazur describes the boulder near Góry, inscribed with 1311 and crossed swords and protected as a natural monument since 1952, at N 54.091900° E 21.430883°, about 12 m away. The Muzeum Warmii i Mazur states that Krwawa Góra near Wopławki and its surroundings witnessed the 1311 fighting and that the stone was set there in 1936 to commemorate the battle. This is a 1936 memorial on the named hill, not a 1311 camp or unit position. No accuracy radius is claimed.
